description: This file contains functions and constants for computing pod signatures used in scheduling optimizations within the Kubernetes framework, including signers for node affinity, tolerations, volumes, and ports.

methods.name: HostPortsSigner
methods.description: Computes a sorted list of host ports used by the pod's containers and init containers.

methods.name: NodeSelectorRequirementsSigner
methods.description: Serializes node selector requirements into sorted JSON strings.

methods.name: NodeSelectorTermSigner
methods.description: Creates a sign result for a node selector term, including match expressions and fields.

methods.name: PreferredSchedulingTermSigner
methods.description: Serializes preferred scheduling terms into sorted JSON strings.

methods.name: NodeSelectorTermsSigner
methods.description: Serializes multiple node selector terms into sorted JSON strings.

methods.name: NodeAffinitySigner
methods.description: Creates a sign result for node affinity, including required and preferred terms.

methods.name: TolerationsSigner
methods.description: Returns sorted tolerations for the pod.

methods.name: VolumesSigner
methods.description: Serializes non-synthetic volume sources of the pod into sorted strings.
